self_contained_context.background: Bug discovered during manual testing: Rich Console does not support 'orange' color name, causing CLI crash when HP drops to 20-40% range
self_contained_context.technical_context:
The _hp_color method returns 'orange' for HP between 20-40%, but Rich Console only supports standard color names or hex/rgb notation.

Error: Failed to get style 'orange'; unable to parse 'orange' as color

Trigger: HP drops from 37 HP to 9 HP (enters 20-40% range)

Solution: Replace 'orange' with a supported color (dark_orange, #FFA500, or yellow)

Phase 7: REVIEW - Execute /dw:review @software-crafter-reviewer (MANDATORY)

Phase 11: COMMIT - Commit with detailed message
